info.title: Kurbis Control Plane API
info.description: Browser JSON API. OAuth callbacks are redirects, server events use SSE, and export downloads stream ZIP data. Worker and gateway protocol routes are intentionally private.

get.description: Begin an OAuth login redirect.
Begin a provider-link redirect for the authenticated account.
Complete OAuth and redirect with an account session cookie.

post.description: Redeem a one-use Minecraft login token; account session cookies are set when signing in.
Redeem a one-use server login token and set a persistent, server-scoped browser grant cookie.

get.description: The skin of the Java player with this name, as a PNG, for the landing page. Needs no session; the x-skin-model header says classic or slim.

200.description: The skin's PNG, 64 by 64 (or 64 by 32, the old layout).

get.description: The whole service at a glance, for the landing page: servers made, servers and players online now, the CPU and memory they use, their ticks per second, the last two hours a minute at a time, and the last thirty days of servers. Needs no session; it may be cached for ten seconds.

200.description: The whole service now, and how it got here.

get.description: Whether a server name is still free. A name is claimed by joining its address in Minecraft.

200.description:
Whether a server name can still be claimed. Names are claimed only by
 joining their address in Minecraft, so this reserves nothing.

post.description: Queue one server console command for the current online placement and return its durable execution record.

requestBody.description: A single server-console command submitted by an authorized browser actor.

post.description: Dispatch one authorized lifecycle command for the server in the path.

requestBody.description:
Canonical lifecycle command wire format at

get.description: Reconnecting server event stream with durable event IDs.

200.description: ServerEvent JSON payloads framed as server-sent events.

get.description: Stream a ready world archive as ZIP bytes.

200.description: Raw ZIP stream; the JSON client does not buffer this response.

put.description: Change the server's AI assistant settings and return the updated overview.

requestBody.description: Per-server AI settings. `None` means "use the gateway default".

requestBody.description: Start a request on behalf of an in-game operator.

post.description: Plugin poll: return tool results, receive pending tool calls and chat lines for operators.

requestBody.description:
One plugin poll: return finished tool results, receive new calls and chat
 lines.

get.description: List the free plugins on the Pumpkin market, each marked with the server's installed copy.

post.description: Plugin only: add a player from in game, recording which player added them. Operators always may; players on the whitelist may while whitelist_by_members is on.

delete.description: Forget a join request without letting the player in.

Owner only, while the owner has no linked Minecraft account: mark a join request as the owner's own player, who goes on the whitelist and becomes an operator. The Minecraft account is not linked for sign-in.

serverGrantCookie.name: kurbis_server_session
serverGrantCookie.description: Persistent server-scoped grant collection. Revoke individual server rows through the scoped session endpoint.

serverCapabilityBearer.description: Placement-scoped plugin capability limited to one server.

gatewayBearer.description: Gateway actor may issue only gateway_join starts.

workerLease.name: x-worker-lease
workerLease.description: Active process lease; required with workerBearer for worker commands.

search.description: Matches account and identity names and emails, or an account id exactly.

last_seen_at.description: The latest request of any of the account's browser sessions.

is_admin.description: Whether the account may read this dashboard.

budgets.description: Null when no model provider is configured.

by_day.description: The last 30 days, oldest first, every day present.

jobs_by_state.description: Requests of the last 30 days by state.

problem_jobs.description: The latest 50 requests that failed or stalled.

top_servers.description: The ten that spent most this month.

AdminAiBudgets.description: The budgets the AI gateway enforces, each a month's spend in millionths of a US dollar.

server_monthly_micros.description: The default for a server; a server may set its own up to the account's.

AdminAiSpender.description: A server or account and what it spent this month.

name.description: The server's address or the account's name; null once it is deleted.

pull_requests.description: Pull requests whose queued build this is.

AdminBuildAlias.description: Where a build is published: a preview hostname and the ref it follows.

builds_by_stage.description: Builds by stage: unfinished ones, and those finished in the last week.

previews.description: Previews not yet expired, latest change first.

queue.description: Pull-request build requests: live ones, and those finished in the last week.

poll_lease_expires_at.description: A poller holds the repository until then.

AdminCohort.description:
The accounts made in one week, and how many of them had their server woken in each
 week after.

returned.description:
Accounts with a wake in UTC calendar week 0 (the week of signup), 1, … up to 7
 after it; only weeks that have begun are listed.

peak_servers_online.description: Highest per-minute sample of the day; null for days nobody sampled.

wakes.description: Successful wakes asked for that day, and the servers they woke.

reference.description:
The failed row: an operation, export, plugin, command, job or build id, a pull
 request number, a webhook delivery or an object key.

AdminFailureGroup.description: Failures that said the same thing, ids and numbers aside.

server_id.description: The latest failure's server, when it had one.

groups.description: The 100 groups seen last, latest first.

paused_until.description: Requests wait until then after GitHub said to slow down.

cohorts.description: The last twelve signup weeks, oldest first.

days.description: Every day since the first account, oldest first.

subject.description: The provider's id for the account; Minecraft identities use the player's UUID.

AdminIdentitySummary.description: A linked sign-in, as the list shows it.

retrying.description: Pending again after a failed attempt.

tasks.description: The tasks of the control plane that answered.

AdminRange.description: How far back a chart looks.

AdminServer.description: A server as the dashboard lists it.

last_woken_at.description: When the latest successful wake was asked for.

stuck.description: In a passing state for more than ten minutes.

samples.description: Over the range, oldest first; minutes the server was not running are missing.

snapshots.description: Every snapshot still kept, newest first, complete or not.

oneOf.description: In a passing state for more than ten minutes.

total.description: Servers matching the filter and search, across every page.

AdminServerSample.description: A server over one bucket of minutes: its most players, and its average usage.

depth.description: Servers waiting for a worker with room.

ahead.description: Servers ahead of this one in the queue.

server_bytes.description: What servers' worlds take, as they last reported.

snapshots.description: Complete snapshots and their total size.

AdminTask.description: One of the control plane's background tasks (start queue, maintenance, CI poller…).

required.description: The control plane is unhealthy while a required task is not running.

cpu_used_millis.description: What its running servers use, from their fresh samples; null when none reported.

lease_expires_at.description: When the running worker process's exclusive lease runs out.

live.description: Heartbeat within the last 30 seconds: it may take new servers.

ports_leased.description: Ports leased to servers and previews.

AdminWorkerPreview.description: A Pumpkin preview placed on a worker.

AdminWorkerServer.description: A server placed on a worker.

reserved_micros.description: Worst-case cost of model calls that are still in flight.

AiDefaults.description: Gateway-wide defaults that apply when a server keeps a setting unset.

AiEffort.description: How much the model thinks before answering.

AiJobDetail.description: One request with every tool call it made.

AiJobEventKind.description: Chat line delivered to the requesting operator.

AiJobRequest.description: Start a request on behalf of an in-game operator.

job_id.description: Client-chosen id; retrying with the same id returns the same job.

new_conversation.description: Start a fresh conversation instead of continuing the operator's last one.

AiModel.description: A model the server owner can choose, with its standard prices.

input_micros_per_mtok.description: Micro-USD per million uncached input tokens.

AiOverview.description: Everything the panel shows about the AI assistant of one server.

available.description: Whether the control plane has a model provider configured.

AiSettings.description: Per-server AI settings. `None` means "use the gateway default".

monthly_budget_micros.description:
Monthly spending cap for this server in micro-USD, at most the
 account's monthly budget.

AiSyncRequest.description:
One plugin poll: return finished tool results, receive new calls and chat
 lines.

after_event_id.description:
Last event id the plugin has seen. Omit it on the first sync: the
 plugin then receives only the lines of requests still running.

cursor.description: Pass back as `after_event_id` on the next sync.

AiToolCall.description: One tool call as recorded for the owner's audit trail.

AiToolCallRequest.description: A tool call the plugin must execute as the requesting operator.

AiToolCallState.description: Execution state of one tool call requested by the model.

AiUsage.description: This calendar month's (UTC) usage of one server and its owner's account.

ConsoleCommandRequest.description: A single server-console command submitted by an authorized browser actor.

FleetSample.description:
The service in one minute, as it was sampled at the start of that minute, or in a
 bucket of minutes starting at `minute` (see [`history`]).

FleetStats.description: The whole service now, and how it got here.

history.description: The last two hours, a sample a minute, oldest first. A minute nobody sampled is missing.

servers_by_day.description: Servers there were at the end of each of the last thirty days, oldest first; the last is today so far.

FleetUsage.description: The running servers' totals at one moment.

cpu_total_millis.description: CPU of every live worker, in thousandths of a core.

cpu_used_millis.description: CPU the running servers use, in thousandths of a core.

tps.description: The running servers' average ticks per second.

added_by.description:
The player in game who adds them. An operator always may; a player on
 the whitelist may while the server's `whitelist_by_members` setting is on.

name.description: The player to add, as Pumpkin named them.

player_id.description:
The UUID Pumpkin reported when it turned this player away. A Bedrock
 player who has never been on the server cannot be resolved by name, so
 the runtime that saw them vouches for it, as it does for the player
 roster. Without it the name is resolved like a panel addition.

JoinRequest.description: A player the whitelist turned away in the last day.

attempts.description: How often they tried, as the server reported it (at most once a minute).

player_id.description: The UUID Pumpkin gave the player it turned away.

market_plugin_id.description: The market listing to install, or to update to its latest version.

MarketPlugin.description: One free plugin listed on the Pumpkin market.

icon_url.description: HTTPS image on the market's asset host.

installed_plugin_id.description: The installed copy of this listing on the server, if any.

query.description:
Matches names, developers, categories and descriptions; at most 64
 characters are used.

name.description:
Java names are resolved with Mojang. Bedrock names resolve only while
 the player is online on this server or already has a stored roster entry.

PluginSource.description: Where an installed plugin came from.

PluginState.description:
Whether the runtime runs the installed binary. `pending` means the
 runtime has not loaded this binary yet; a sleeping server loads it when
 it next starts.

file_name.description: The uploaded file's name; its stem names the plugin.

generation.description: The placement generation that produced this sample.

measured_at.description: Assigned by the control plane when the sample is persisted.

ServerAddress.description:
Whether a server name can still be claimed. Names are claimed only by
 joining their address in Minecraft, so this reserves nothing.

ServerCommandRequest.description:
Canonical lifecycle command wire format at
 `POST /api/v1/servers/{server_id}/commands`.

ServerIdPath.description:
A server id extracted from the request path together with the canonical
 server row.  Authorization remains actor-specific and is performed by the
 handler/command service; this extractor only normalizes path lookup and the
 not-found response.

search.description: Matches addresses and owner names, or a server or owner id exactly.

ServerPlugin.description: One plugin installed on a server.

error.description: Why the runtime could not load this binary.

market_plugin_id.description: The market listing this plugin was installed from.

runtime_name.description: The name and version the plugin reported when the runtime loaded it.

synchronized.description: Whether a running server has loaded the current list.

whitelist_by_members.description:
Players on the whitelist may let in someone the whitelist just turned
 away. Operators always can.

is_admin.description: The account may read the operator dashboard and every server.

owner_has_minecraft_account.description:
Whether the owner's account has a linked Minecraft account, which is
 always on the whitelist and an operator. Without one the owner can
 mark a join request as their own.

requests.description: Players turned away in the last day, most recent first.

whitelist_by_members.description: Whether players on the whitelist may let in someone it turned away.

added_by.description:
Who put the player on the whitelist: the owner's account name for
 additions in the panel, the player's name for additions in game.
 Unknown for a login-link session and for entries older than this field.

added_in_game.description: Whether the player was added from inside the game.

name.description:
The Minecraft name to resolve. Java names are looked up through Mojang;
 Bedrock names resolve only from this server's live players or stored roster.
